Covers inventory caching via [defaults] fact settings or [inventory] settings, and per-plugin cache, cache_plugin, cache_timeout, cache_connection and cache_prefix options.

answer_card.title: Caching dynamic inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
Hosts missing the variables a group or compose rule uses (like `tags.Name` or `private_ip_address`) simply aren't added to those groups, and `ansible_host` isn't changed.

Per-plugin caching in the source file:

```yaml
plugin: amazon.aws.aws_ec2
cache: true
cache_plugin: ansible.builtin.jsonfile
cache_timeout: 7200
cache_connection: /tmp/aws_inventory
cache_prefix: aws_ec2
```

Or in `ansible.cfg`, using fact cache defaults plus inventory settings:

```ini
[defaults]
fact_caching = ansible.builtin.jsonfile
fact_caching_connection = /tmp/ansible_facts
cache_timeout = 3600

[inventory]
cache = yes
cache_connection = /tmp/ansible_inventory
```
